**[DS-10]** Check Point Research. "Caught in the Hook: RCE and API Token

- URL: https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/rce-and-api-token-exfiltration-through-claude-code-project-files-cve-2025-59536/

**[DS-11]** Pillar Security. "New Vulnerability in GitHub Copilot and Cursor:
Rules File Backdoor."
